title: valeriana sorbifolia var. mexicana
intro: Valeriana sorbifolia var. mexicana, commonly known as Mexican valerian, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Valerianaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Mexican valerian are attributed to its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates. The bioactive constituents in Mexican valerian are responsible for its therapeutic effects and have been used to treat a range of health conditions, including insomnia, restlessness, and muscle spasms.
